title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #034 · 매체 믹스 · 대각 띠·매끈 · 5영역(팝아트 코믹+헨나+유화 임파스토+사이아노타입+이레즈미) · 풀커버 · towering hourglass · 오른 힙 팝 · Middle Eastern · 배경 앙코르와트 회랑 · 아게하
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, early 30s goddess, towering hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a towering frame with legs that seem endless, thick smooth thighs and calves, hips wide and rounded, a sharply cinched narrow waist pulled in far tighter than her bust and hips, and a full heavy bust high on her chest; her height and long legs make every curve look longer and more dramatic; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sculpted updo copper red hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 diagonal bands by 4 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 14% of the way down her figure from the top, about 41% of the way down her figure from the top, about 58% of the way down her figure from the top and about 75% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries pop-art comic panels with bold black outlines, flat red, yellow and blue shapes and big speech bursts. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries dark brown Arabic henna lacework with large flowers and leafy vines. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries thick impasto oil paint in cadmium yellow and viridian, heavy palette-knife ridges catching the light. Region 4 is the diagonal band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries deep Prussian-blue cyanotype prints with white fern and leaf silhouettes. Region 5 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo art in bold black ink outlines with indigo, crimson and white waves, clouds and peonies flowing over her curves. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, her legs fully in view — most extreme towering hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy pastel pink leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in pastel pink lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows high gloss body oil, heavily oiled glistening skin, wet-look shine.

Background: the carved stone galleries of Angkor Wat with sunlit sandstone paving, standard-height doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
